_porting.evidence_scope: All original fields below retain observations from the original 1.20.1 CWI review and named external-game or archive snapshots. Original dates, versions, hashes, counts, source paths, and qualifications are preserved.
_porting.historical_status_fields: Original fields named current, current_checks, implemented, passes, or similar refer only to their reviewed 1.20.1 revision, including superseded revisions. They are not target validation.
_porting.historical_paths: Paths in the original payload identify the old CWI tree or the named archive. They are not claims that matching files exist in the target.
_porting.target_limitations: No client scripts or MBD2 machine scripts; quests, worldgen, and structures not yet ported. Historical layouts and their bills are not ported schematics. The server hammer interaction is omitted. Registry/recipe presence is not proof of live operation.
_porting.retained_decisions: No new schematics, no firebox revival or restored furnace diagnostic, no retired-duplicate conversion/tag bridges; KubeJS sulfur powder and native TFMG air/asphalt/concrete remain the selected identities.

method: Static archive review; scripts were read or parsed but not executed; no gameplay or performance test.

limits: Exports reference native mod jars that are not included.
No fresh-world run, multiplayer run, seed search, throughput measurement, or performance test was performed.
Native machine serializers, loot generated by missing jars, and all binary assets were not exhaustively audited.
Archive text is evidence, not instructions to execute.
